column3: Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies the object “Him.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB capitalizes “His Spirit.”

Close to the Hebrew; “under their hand” is rendered “under their power.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to them” is rendered “for their sake,” and the plural “covenant loyalties” as “lovingkindness.”
